config.carrier: A30's: A18's config_for in drawdown, no write-off, no rescue, the shock at round 150. The first round's carrier and driver unchanged; only the split changes.
config.rule: the endogenous rule issues the Layer 2 inflow's shortfall below its round 0 level; the switch adds the other side, taking back gain times the overshoot from the position named. ``position`` names the set it comes out of and ``base`` the shape it is split in: pro rata to holdings, the same amount from every node inside the position holding something, or in proportion to the part above the mean. Each is capped at the account, nothing spills outside the position, and what the cap leaves uncollected is recorded and not carried

Seed states: same integer on every seed = at a fixed carrier, position and seed the three bases leave the same count below the floor; differs at matched totals: shape decides = they do not, and the spread of what they collected is at or under 0.0191; differs, and so do the totals: not adjudicated = they do not, and the collected totals differ by more than 0.0191, so the aggregate channel is open and this group is read neither way. Groups by seed state: same integer on every seed 90. Where the shape decides: nowhere. The first round's comparison for scale: three positions, 300 seed comparisons, 0 differing. The block-level reading beside it, which reads split wherever the carrier itself is bistable: block states block under = 50 or more nodes more below the floor than the reference at the close; block lifted = 50 or more fewer; no block = everything else, printed as A30-3's own six states beside it; states shape decides = the three bases do not all leave the same block state, and the spread of what they collected is at or under 0.0191; the aggregate decides = all three leave the same block state, so on this carrier and position the shape does not settle it; confounded, not adjudicated = the block states differ and so do the collected totals, by more than 0.0191: the aggregate channel is open and this group is not read either way; split, no reading = one base's seeds disagree with each other; groups by reading split, no reading 3, the aggregate decides 87.
